Grok Build CLI fixture excerpt (redacted).

Flags used by Delegate v1:
  --cwd <CWD>
  --prompt-file <PATH>
  --output-format plain|json|streaming-json
  --permission-mode default|acceptEdits|auto|dontAsk|bypassPermissions|plan
  --sandbox <PROFILE>
  --disable-web-search
  --effort <LEVEL>  [possible values: low, medium, high, xhigh, max]
  --reasoning-effort <EFFORT>
  --json-schema <SCHEMA>  (implies --output-format json)
  --no-subagents
  --always-approve

Reasoning effort enum (from --effort help): low, medium, high, xhigh, max
